blocks.text: Got a presentation for school? AI helps you plan it and make it interesting – but you're the one who makes it and presents it.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Ask for a plan: how many slides and what goes on each.
For each slide: a title + 3 short points (not whole sentences!).
Ask for an interesting opening – a question or a surprising fact.
Ask for picture ideas, then find the pictures yourself or draw them.
Practise presenting out loud – the AI can ask you questions like an audience.

blocks.text: I'm 13 and I'm making a school presentation about whales, 6 slides, 5 minutes. Suggest slide titles, 3 short points for each, and one interesting question to open with.
Check the facts on your slides in a book or on a reliable website. And list your sources at the end – teachers love that!
Act as my class. I've just finished my presentation about whales. Ask me 3 questions that students and the teacher might ask.
